title: Minority indicator for a Boolean function
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the sign cube, define its minority indicator at $x$ to be $(1-f(x))/2$ when the mean of $f$ is nonnegative, and $(1+f(x))/2$ when that mean is negative.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
